# SF-019 audio rights and provenance

This local WAV preview uses the Guitar-TECHS Player3 take03 direct-input guitar
recording, credited to Hegel Emmanuel Pedroza Villalobos, Termeh Taheri,
Wallace Abreu, Ryan M. Corey and Iran R. Roman (ICASSP 2025).
Source: https://zenodo.org/records/14963133
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The pinned source archive prepared 48 kHz mono PCM16 20 s excerpt has SHA-256
75ae5e73c72e6774fb75e6318dc91ba66347fb65290949e947144033eb648f52.
The SF-019 runner takes its first 8 s, applies 0.8 software gain, and adds
2 seconds of wet-tail computation. The healthy/fault runs use the identical
input and controls; only damagedMount changes the modeled gap. Raw files
retain their true levels; additional matched files apply disclosed whole-file
RMS gains *after* processing. No claim of pickup voltage or calibrated codec
level. See the conversation's plate preview ZIP for the actual WAVs; these
are not committed as binary source files to the branch.

Do not infer rights in other Guitar-TECHS recordings or in Parable's code from
the license on this audio recording.
